title: Lab - Environment variables and ConfigMaps
description: Wire configuration into a Pod three ways.
scenario: Wire configuration into a Pod three ways. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Literal
tasks.instructions: Create ConfigMap webapp-config-map with APP_COLOR=darkblue and APP_OTHER=disregard.

tasks.title: Task 2 - envFrom
tasks.instructions: Make Pod webapp-color read APP_COLOR from that ConfigMap.
tasks.solution: # env: [{name: APP_COLOR, valueFrom: {configMapKeyRef: {name: webapp-config-map, key: APP_COLOR}}}]
tasks.verification: kubectl exec webapp-color -- env | grep APP_COLOR

tasks.title: Task 3 - Volume
tasks.instructions: Mount the ConfigMap as files under /etc/config.
